result.title: LiveLoRA: Exact KV Cache Migration Across LoRA Updates for LLM Agents
result.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop AgenticOS: Co-designing Systems and ML Foundations of an OS Layer for Agentic AI
result.summary: Updating an LLM adapter should not require replaying the full interaction history of every active session. Yet reusing key-value (KV) cache entries computed under an earlier version mixes model versions, while full-history re-prefill becomes increasingly costly as histories and session fleets grow. We introduce LiveLora, a model-runtime co-design for exact final-block KV cache migration. Frozen lower decoder blocks and fixed K/V adapter down-projections preserve each token's base projections and low-rank coordinates across adapter versions. The runtime reconstructs candidate K/V, reevaluates the latest token through the final block, and commits the adapter, cache, and next-token logits together. We prove continuation equivalence to full-history re-prefill in exact arithmetic under the stated model assumptions. On Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, median paired publication speedups over full-history re-prefill average $68.98\times$ across five runs for 32 active sessions with 8K tokens each. Serving benchmarks show approximately 4.8% decoding overhead relative to native cached decoding. Compared with retained-boundary replay, compact retention gives a $3.42\times$ reduction in additional session storage at 8K, with similar measured publication-plus-decoding cost. LiveLora allows persistent LLM agents to adopt new adapter versions without replaying their full interaction histories.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LiveLoRA，一种模型与运行时协同设计：利用冻结的下层解码块与固定的 K/V 低秩下投影，使每个 token 的基投影与低秩坐标在 adapter 版本切换后保持一致，再通过末层块重算最近 token，完成 KV cache、adapter 与下一 token logits 的同步提交。作者在精确算术下证明其与全历史重新 prefill 的续写等价，并在 Qwen2.5-3B 上报告相对全历史重算的中位加速与较低解码开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「缓存状态在模型版本变化后是否仍可复用、如何判定等价」的论证方式，可能为 LVR 中 latent/注意力缓存的跨步骤复用与失效条件提供可核查的参考线索，但该文面向 agent 服务效率而非视觉推理，迁移需自行判断。
